description: This file defines an interface class 'ControlBackendInterface' within the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. The interface declares two pure virtual functions: 'removeControlBackend' and 'waitForRunning', intended for managing control backend operations in a client context.

classes.name: ControlBackendInterface
classes.description: An interface class for control backend operations, providing methods to remove the backend and wait for it to be in a running state.

methods.name: removeControlBackend
methods.description: Pure virtual method to remove or clean up the control backend.

methods.name: waitForRunning
methods.description: Pure virtual method that waits until the control backend is in a running state, returning true if successful.
